summary: Cloudastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to disclose the delay of its Form 10-Q for Q1 2026 past the extended deadline due to a technical accounting issue with preferred equity instruments. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital event is present. The press release attached maintains preliminary revenue guidance of ~$1.3M (78% YoY growth) and gross profit growth of 115% YoY. This is a routine disclosure of a filing delay with no change-of-control, tender, or strategic review component. It does not constitute a special situation.
